arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,importlib
m=importlib.import_module('oauthlib.oauth2.rfc6749.tokens')
actual=Path(m.__file__).resolve();expected=(Path.cwd()/'oauthlib/oauth2/rfc6749/tokens.py').resolve()
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
from oauthlib.common import Request
from oauthlib.oauth2.rfc6749.tokens import BearerToken
seen = {}
class V:
    def validate_bearer_token(self, token, scopes, request):
        seen.update(token=token, scopes=scopes, request=request)
        return True
req = Request('https://example.com/res', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer tok123'})
req.scopes = ['s']
t = BearerToken(request_validator=V())
assert t.validate_request(req) is True
print('observed', seen['token'], seen['scopes'], seen['request'] is req)
assert seen['token'] == 'tok123' and seen['scopes'] == ['s'] and seen['request'] is req
PYREPLAY
